author: E.L. Layard, 1854
summary: 국내에서는 제주 마라도에서 2022년 5월과 2024년 4월에 관찰된 기록이 있는 길잃은새이다. 숲 아래층의 낮은 가지에 조용히 앉아 있다가 날아올라 곤충을 잡으며, 번식지에서는 그늘진 숲의 개울가를 즐겨 찾는다. 인도 동북부와 미얀마 북부에서 중국 남서부·남부에 걸쳐 번식하고 인도 남서부와 스리랑카에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: rufous uppertail coverts and edges to the flight feathers

young: 어린새(유조)는 갈색 윗면에 황갈색 점무늬가 있고, 가슴깃 가장자리가 검어 비늘무늬처럼 보인다. 첫해 개체는 큰날개덮깃 끝의 담황색 무늬가 어른새보다 뚜렷하다.

art.subject: Brown-breasted Flycatcher (Muscicapa muttui), adult (sexes alike), a vagrant spring migrant in Korean island woodland: crown and face grey-brown with a whitish eye-ring and a whitish line from the bill to the eye; upperparts warm olive-brown, the rump and uppertail coverts more rufous; wings dark brown with rufous-buff fringes to the greater coverts and broad rufous edges to the tertials and secondaries; throat white; breast and flanks washed plain brown; belly white; tail warm brown with a rufous tinge. Bill fairly large and broad, upper mandible dark, lower mandible wholly pale yellowish; eye dark; legs pale pinkish-yellow.
art.pose: perched upright on a low branch in shaded understorey, side view
art.scene: shady broadleaf woodland on a Korean offshore island during spring migration (May), soft dappled light; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched upright on a low branch: large head, conspicuous pale eye-ring and pale lores, broad bill with a pale lower mandible, olive-brown upperparts, brighter rufous uppertail coverts, dark brown wings with rufous edges to the flight feathers, warm brown tail, pale pink legs
adult, three-quarter front view perched upright: conspicuous pale eye-ring, pale lower mandible, pale throat, plain pale brown breast and flanks without streaks, whitish belly, pale pink legs
art.build: Small flycatcher, smaller than a sparrow but slightly larger and bigger-billed than Asian Brown Flycatcher; large head and upright posture. Bill broad-based and flat, shorter than the head but long for a Muscicapa, with a fully pale lower mandible. Legs short, pale pinkish-yellow, a key difference from the dark-legged Asian Brown Flycatcher. Primary projection shorter than in Asian Brown Flycatcher. Tail square, medium length, without white.
avoid: Do not paint black or dark grey legs; Brown-breasted Flycatcher's legs are pale pinkish-yellow (Asian Brown Flycatcher has dark legs).
Do not paint a dark lower mandible; the whole lower mandible is pale.
Do not streak the breast (Grey-streaked or Dark-sided Flycatcher); the breast is a plain brown wash.
Do not make the upperparts cold grey; they are warm brown with rufous wing edges.
